title: smol init — inline setup wizard
source_brief: Approved plan v4: interactive-only smol init; repository presets plus built-in Default and Existing, optional face with preset/seed/random-once/random-each-run and static preview/reroll, 21 system modules, per-module field selection, order and colors, preserved display/module options, shell instructions, review and explicit create/replace confirmation. No writes on precommit cancel. Design specification only.
assumptions: All wizard behavior is proposed, not implemented or runtime verified.
Presets: Default plus the shipped minimal, banner, prompt and server files; each replaces only its defined keys.
All 21 current system modules are selectable alphabetically; optional face is configured separately.
Field selection covers only enabled modules that declare fields, with at most one field per module.
Display and per-module option tables pass through unchanged; presets may set disk mount.
XDG_CONFIG_DIRS is ignored for init destinations and bases.
Static previews illustrate semantic output, not faithful terminal execution.
Files may contain local uncommitted changes; this package changes no application source.
Atomic rename prevents partial content; uncooperative concurrent writers can still race the last existing-file snapshot check.
